title: IndigoReach - Giving Wings to Fly
summary: The seminar at Valia College was very good & well received. Thank you to Bharat Cares for the incredible support & a fantastic session.
description:
The seminar at Valia College was very good & well received.

Thank you to Bharat Cares for the incredible support & a fantastic session.

The highlight of the day is that Principal Mr. Deepak Nanaware has given us two new college/university connects! And he has asked us to come back in Phase 3 for a bigger session.
